probes.result: Proxy sees nested write-and-restore made through its own view; equality alone misses it.
Already captured raw alias bypasses a later proxy, including write-and-restore.
Freeze prevents the raw mutation, but a callback can swallow that attempt; no proxy trace records it.
State proxy/equality cannot stop an independently captured writer. This writer is a local counter, not I/O.
A proposed callback-free constant-identity boundary avoids executing continuation code.
